components.name: Solar Cells (monocrystalline silicon)
components.reasoning: Essential photovoltaic conversion element, universally present as a separate unit in all monocrystalline PV modules.

components.name: Tempered Glass Cover
components.reasoning: Protective front layer to ensure durability and optimal light transmission, industry-standard protective component.

components.name: Aluminum Frame (extruded or pressed)
components.reasoning: Provides structural support and facilitates mounting, standard in most PV module designs.

components.name: Junction Box
components.reasoning: Houses electrical connections and safety components like bypass diodes, essential for safe operation.

components.name: Encapsulation Material (EVA or EPE)
components.reasoning: Seals the cells between the glass cover and backsheet, industry-standard protective layer though other materials like POE are emerging.

components.name: Backsheet
components.reasoning: Rear protection shield with electrical insulation properties; often used in conventional module designs but glass-glass variants exist.

components.name: Solder Bars
components.reasoning: Conductive strips used for internal cell connections, though often built into solar cells, they are still distinct manufacturing components.

components.name: Insulating Spacer Sheets (EVA or POE)
components.reasoning: Used to maintain electrical insulation between the glass and other panels; while integral, some newer designs integrate this functionally.

components.name: Temperature Sensors
components.reasoning: Typically optional but useful for performance monitoring; present as part of more advanced or specialized PV systems.

components.name: Adhesive Tape (EVA-based)
components.reasoning: Used in the encapsulation process but primarily attached during production rather than a separate module; however, its distinct application warrants mention.
